name: Aberrant Zealot (Variant)
subjectPrompt: A single hunched humanoid occult zealot transformed by alien psychic influence. Hollow-eyed ashen face partially framed by dark wet-looking hair and the collar of a tattered moss-black mantle. A few slender green-black tendrils unfurl from an asymmetrical shoulder and curl close to the back, suggesting an unstable body. Worn studded leather under long strips of dark olive cloth and beaten bronze buckles. Human-sized, with lean unnaturally pliant limbs, long fingers and one open hand lifting a dim pale lilac psychic glimmer. Show the whole figure upright, in a wary three-quarter stance. Borrow the silhouette and organic shoulder details from the second reference but use a distinct pose and expression. Keep the face recognizably humanoid, no beak, no octopus head, no eyeball coverage, no wounds, no blood, no other creature.

name: Iarno "Glasstaff" Albrek
subjectPrompt: Iarno Albrek, a slight middle-aged human wizard with short, swept black hair, a neat black beard and moustache, and an alert calculating look. His practical traveling clothes are a dark navy doublet, ash-cream sleeves, booted legs, fine leather gloves and a dark cloak with a fur-lined collar. A red leather spellbook and scroll cases hang at his hip. His distinctive weapon is a long transparent glass staff, with an unmistakably clear shaft and a sculpted flared fork of translucent glass at the tip, catching narrow blue and amber reflections. Pose him turned three quarters, one hand holding the staff upright, his other hand lowered and out of his pocket. Design a new pose with the face, coat palette and staff materials informed by the second reference. Full head and body visible, one figure only, without the companion from the reference. Neutral guarded expression, no text.
